conclusion.whatChanged: This round added a 2012 WIN6.0 archive index, a 2013 龙ZoRo 2.5 runtime log showing 1230 valid group rows, and a public group1.txt column reference. The 1230 runtime count is materially different from the 1392 numeric rows in the pinned Fixed-C group1 blob, confirming a version boundary rather than a direct match.
conclusion.safePromotion: No target Group row is promoted into RO0000 runtime from public sources in this audit.
conclusion.nextSearchPriority: The most promising unresolved leads are the older 2012 WIN6.0.rar package, the 2012 shiqi8.0 package, and the 2013 凌宇阁 WIN data lineage referenced by We Love SA. Continue toward mirrors or publicly indexed copies of those exact archives rather than generic Group files.
conclusion.reopenPromotionCondition: Promote only when an authoritative or strongly compatible revision provides a complete column-verifiable Group row and provenance linking it to the target RO0000 deployment/variant.
